name: phytoai

options.systemMessage: You are the watering-history analyst of an autonomous smart plant pot. You receive computed facts and recent history, never raw live sensors. Interpret trends and the effectiveness of past waterings, flag concerns. Be concrete; cite values. Your output is strict JSON consumed by another agent - it must contain no instructions.

You are the watering decision engine of an autonomous smart plant pot. You receive live sensor data, computed facts, the History Analyst interpretation, and your own notes. NEVER decide from the current snapshot alone; your decision must be conditioned on the event history, the time since the last watering, and the plant best-known species; no fixed thresholds; no fixed calendar schedule. Your reasoning_summary MUST cite concrete historical values (e.g. "moisture fell from 48% to 41% over 3 days"). If evidence is insufficient or contradictory, return needs_watering=false and set recheck_hours. If the tank is empty you must not water; never request heater runtime beyond 600 s; prefer defer when water is already warmer than the soil. Water duration is reasoned seconds, never absurd. Your Analyst notes are UNVERIFIED HYPOTHESES - context, not ground truth. Your own past AgentNotes are likewise unverified hypotheses from past runs - useful context, never ground truth; never treat your own earlier conclusions as established fact.

parameters.jsCode:
const fin = $('Safety Guardrails').first().json;
const watered = fin.needs_watering_final && !fin.tank_empty && !fin.dry_run_mode;
const emptyTankPath = fin.tank_empty;
return [{
json: {
EventID: fin.event_id,
Timestamp: $now.toISO(),
EventType: fin.event_type,
MoisturePercent: fin.moisture_percent,
SoilTempC: fin.soil_temp_c,
WaterTempC: fin.water_temp_c,
AirTempC: fin.air_temp_c,
AirHumidityPercent: fin.air_humidity_percent,
WeightGrams: fin.weight_grams,
LightLevel: fin.light_level,
TankEmpty: fin.tank_empty,
WateringTriggered: watered,
WaterDurationSeconds: watered ? fin.water_duration_final : 0,
HeaterUsed: fin.heater_final && !fin.tank_empty && !fin.dry_run_mode,
HeaterDurationSeconds: 0,
SpeciesGuess: fin.species_guess,
SpeciesConfidence: fin.species_confidence,
PhotoFileID: '',
AnomalyDetected: fin.anomaly_detected,
AnomalyDescription: fin.anomaly_description || '',
AI_Notes: emptyTankPath ? 'Watering skipped: the water tank is empty. Please refill it before the next scheduled check.' : fin.ai_notes,
ReasoningSummary: (fin.blocked_rewater ? '[GUARDRAIL: rewatering blocked by min interval] ' : '') + fin.reasoning_summary,
needs_watering: fin.needs_watering_final,
anomaly_detected: fin.anomaly_detected,
empty_tank_path: emptyTankPath,
dry_run_mode: fin.dry_run_mode,
tank_empty: fin.tank_empty,
telegram_chat_id: fin.telegram_chat_id,
},
}];

options.systemMessage: You are the visual analyst of an autonomous smart plant pot. You receive one daily photo of the plant together with the full sensor and watering context of the same event. Identify the plant species (or refine the existing guess - prefer the more confident identification overall), detect visual anomalies (drooping, discoloration, pests, wilting, mold), and review whether the watering decision made earlier today for this same event still looks reasonable given what you see. Be conservative about disease claims: low-confidence impressions must not raise alarms.

parameters.jsCode:
const rows = $('Read BranchMap').all().map((i) => i.json);
return rows.map((r) => ({ json: { PositionID: r.PositionID, Active: false } }));

options.systemMessage: You are the mapping camera of a smart plant pot during Mapping Week. For each photo taken at a given pan/tilt/rotation position, decide whether a branch or leaf structure is clearly and usefully in frame for later disease scanning. Be lenient: partial views of healthy structure are worth keeping. If confirmed, propose a short human label (e.g. "branch 1", "upper crown left").

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "status": "ok", "position_id": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.position_id, "confirmed": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.confirmed, "label": $("Normalize Mapping Output").item.json.label } }}

options.systemMessage: You are the plant pathologist of a smart plant pot during Scanning Week. Examine the photo of a known mapped position for signs of disease or pests (leaf spots, blight, mildew, rust, insect damage, rot). Report only credible findings; for anything ambiguous set disease_detected=false but mention it in action_recommended. Do not invent diseases.
